balls.text: low dipping full toss around off, driven to long-on for a single
full and straight, driven to covers for a single
the slower one outside off, a length delivery, DK slices it straight to backward point
walks right across the stumps and laps the full toss from outside  off stump line to the backward square-leg boundary
low full toss on the off stump line, DK punches it towards the straight boundary and Birt moves across from long-on to make a diving stop
banged in short ; DK  goes for the pull and top -edges it to the fine-leg boundary
moves towards off and tries to paddle sweep it but Irfan follows him with a slightly slower delivery. The ball rolls out to backward square-leg region. another good over from Irfan
stays back to tap this to cover for a single
Clatter! Irfan pings the leg stump. Mandeep cleared his front foot and went for a big slog to the leg but missed the full delivery.

Sreeram  back in action again. Irfan in angry mode again. It was pulled to right of deep midwicket and Sreeram rushes across and lunges out. He gets hirght hand to it but the ball runs away to the boundary

Irfan can't believe that the deep midwicket fielder (sreeram) has failed to catch it.  It was pulled high to the right of the deep midwicket who misjudged it badly. He ended up running around in circles and didn't get close to the ball.
lands on the middle stump line and the batsman tries to move outside leg and cut. The ball flies over the middle stump
backs away outside leg but Morne cramps him by following him with a fullish delivery; DK jabs it to the bowler
Salt and pepper time. DK square cuts this short delivery outside off to backward point boundary
loud cry for a catch by the keeper. No response from the ump. DK walked across the stumps and went for the pull. And replays suggest it went off the gloves. Dk escapes.
length delivery on the off stump line, dabbed down to Venu at third man
moved outside leg, the ball follows him and he tucks it to midwicket
gets forward to push this through covers for a single
walks across to work this behind square-leg
short in length outside off, chopped to backward point
David hasn't done much with the bat this ipl and here is another failure for him. He cleared the front foot and went for the pull but found the midwicket fielder
banged in short and DK top-edges the pull. The ball lands safely beyond square-leg

Naman can't seem to stop anything. DK shuffled across the stump and lapped the short of length delivery to left of the keeper who should have stopped it on the bounce. But doesn't. Nadeem, though, runs across to make a fine diving stop at fine-leg boundary
a slower short delivery and David picks it up very late but adjusts in the end to swat it through midwicket
goes for the quick yorker and DK digs it out back to the bowler

Dropped by the keeper Naman Ojha DK was beaten for pace and bounce again as he went for the cut. The ball went off the edge and went to right of Naman who couldn't hold on. Varun is steaming in anger and disappointment.
a length delivery outside off whooshes past the attempted flamboyant cut!
full in length on the middle, tapped to off side for a single
stays back to guide the back-of-length delivery to left of backward point
shortish delivery outside off, DK can't connect with his cut shot
The bouncer arrives now and it climbs very high over DK. David Hussey wanted to steal a bye as the keeper was way back but he has to get back in a hurry as Dk doesn't respond
tries to serve a full delivery but slips it down the leg side
stays back to run this back-of-length delivery to third man
Karthik tries to pull this but the ball tails down the leg side for a wide
gets back and across to defend this to the off side
keeps out the hat-trick ball with a dab to point

A pumped-up Irfan  hops in joy. The off stump has gone for a night-out. It was the full delivery but Paul was so frozen on the back foot. He was perhaps again expecting a short ball. The ball curved in the air, landed full around off and darted back in. Paul was in panic mode by now; he  crouched and tried to stab it. No luck. The ball curved in, went through the bat and pad gap and took out the off stump
Irfan takes out Shaun. It landed back of length and moved away from the off stump. Marsh went for a big flat-batted heave across the line and top edged it. Morne ran in from third man to collect it.
curves away from the off stump, Marsh tries to cut it and misses.
moves outside leg and goes for a slog across the line. The keeper collected the ball.
short of length delivery on the leg stump line, turned to midwicket
Wham bham. It was the short delivery and Shaun swiveled to unfurl a violent pull to the square-leg boundary
full and straight, Paul was on the back foot- perhaps he was expecting something shorter- and ends up playing an ungainly scoop shot through mid-on
on the leg and middle line, tucked quietly to midwicket
moves outside leg, Morne follows him with a high full toss, pushed out to mid-off for a single that brings him the Orange Cap
Clubbed! It lands on the roof! H u  g e. Marsh got down on his knee and proposed. The ball sailed high over long-on boundary. Boom!
drags this short and Marsh crash-pulls it to the square-leg boundary
skips down the track and lifts it straight. Very nicely done. He focused on getting the timing and the placement right
tries to tonk this to the straight boundary but ends up slicing it over point
goes down on his knee and goes for the slog sweep. He didn't quite connect as well as he would have liked but the ball just about clears the leaping fielder at deep midwicket
from over the wicket, on the leg stump line, turned through midwicket
shortish delivery at the ribcage, Paul short-arm stabs it weakly through backward square-leg region
A bouncer this time and Paul goes down under
full in length and outside off, Paul throws his bat at it but the ball had already flashed past him

Hopes' pace was fine to deal with but Varun's pace is proving a tad difficult. Paul moved outside leg and is late on the cut. He was also cramped for room as the bowler followed him with a shortish delivery
drives this full delivery but straight to covers
around that off stump line, steered to third man
Bosh! No edge this time. Pure violence. He backed away slightly and unfurled a crashing pull to wide long-on boundary. The ball landed on the ropes I think. It should be a six and it is
50 up. Another edge. He moved outside leg and tried to cut it over point. The ball flew off the top edge and ran away to the third man boundary
Wham! Paul moves outside leg stump and has a big go at this. He heaves this shortish delivery over long-on

Almost caught by Warner. What an effort. It was a shortish delivery outside off and Paul arched back and punched it high to the right of sweeper cover. Warner rushed across and dived even as the ball was dying on him. He even got his palms under the ball but couldn't hang on.
slower one, around off stump line, driven to extra cover
the bouncer arrives now and Paul looks to be caught in the danger zone. The ball keeps moving towards him and at the very end, he gets his bat up and swats the ball past square-leg
Edged to third man boundary. Paul moves outside leg and looks to punch it up and over the off side. The bounce and pace does him in but he gets a lucky fat edge
This one kicks up from back of length even as it straightens outside off and Paul is beaten by that extra bounce. The ball flies over the blade
stays back to turn it to square-leg region
More troubles with that pull shot. Again beaten for pace. Marsh is late on the shot and the ball rolls away to mid-off
Almost a catch at midwicket. Marsh went for the pull and ended up mistiming it completely but it falls short of Hopes
turns this to square-leg region
short of length and Paul plays an ugly swat to mid-on region
pushes this to the off for a single

edged but no slip in place. It was another delivery cutting away from him, from that leg and middle line, and yet again Marsh is in trouble. He prefers to stay still on the leg-stump line and since the ball is cutting away from him, from that line, he pushes out at them. This time the ball flew off the edge and flies through vacant slips
cuts away from Marsh who tries to defend and ends up edging it on to his pad flap
runs this down to Morkel at third man for a single
just outside off, Marsh guides it to backward point
width outside off and Marsh crashes it to the point boundary. Whack.
reaches across to tap this to backward point
around the off stump, steered away to the off side
works this to the leg side for a single

pulled over fine-leg fielder! It was a short ball on the leg and middle line and Paul pulled it. There was a fielder near the boundary but he rushed in. Mistake. The ball sailed over him and over the ropes. Had he stood at the line, he would have taken it. It's Varun Aaron
more wides down the leg side. The keeper fumbles the take
good delivery, cutting right across Marsh who is beaten, pushing at it
more troubles for Paul against the short stuff. He plays a weak pull at this shortish delivery and it lobs gently through midwicket
in the zone outside off, left alone
this one didn't climb all that much but Paul had decided to duck too early. The ball just went around waist-high and outside off
this one lands outside off and cuts in sharply even as it bounces around chest-high. Paul ducks to evade it
shortish and well outside off, Paul reaches out but ends up mistiming the cut to the off side.
Fullish and on the middle and leg line, Marsh leans forward and wrists it up and over mid-on in some style. 2000 T20 runs for him
full in length outside off and Marsh presents the high front elbow as he drives it to extra cover
on the middle and off line, pushed out to left of backward point
He is beaten this time, going for a slog. He moved outside leg and just threw his bat at the ball
Ah! neatly done. It was short in length and outside off, Paul got his hands up and played a sliced it up and over backward point.
full in length, straightens on the middle stump line and Marsh gets forward to defend and is hit high on the pad
Swat! It was a short of length delivery and Paul swatted it across the line and it ran away through wide mid-on region.

How did it go to the boundary?! It looked a jab, a stab and a rather indecisive one at that. It was on the middle and leg, and he looked as if he was cramped for room and he tried to work it to the on side. The ball lobbed over square-leg and kept running
Searches for the yorker but sprays it wide down the leg side
The ball continues to move past the edge. Paul went after this delivery outside off but was very late.
digs in a bouncer but it sails down the leg side
tries the yorker, serves a full toss to Paul, who backed away to the leg side, and mistimed the shot to mid-on
short and bouncing outside off and Paul can't get bat to ball. He goes under the ball which climbs more than he thinks it would
stays back to push this to the off side
Paul is in trouble with this extra bounce from Morne. He hops and pokes at a shortish delivery outside off and edges it to third man
turned to the leg side for a single
full and on the middle and off line, pushed out to covers

The slog is over. Gilly falls. He never looked in. He moved outside leg and charged down the track. Brave move. No luck though. He went for the slog to the leg side but didn't connect properly and ended up lobbing the ball to mid-on
dropped by Venugopal rao at first slip. Paul went for the big on-the-up drive and it flew straight to Venu who gets his palms in line but ends up clanging it
length delivery outside off and Paul stays beside the line and lifts it over extra cover!
He is in the slog mood. He charges down the track and flat-bats a shortish delivery over the bowler.
turned to the leg side for a single

Run out of Gilly missed! and four  (five?)overthrows. What an absolute mess. It was pushed to point region and Gilly ran. Paul froze. Gilly kept running. Yogesh caught the ball and Gilly slipped. Paul started to run.  Irfan was near the stumps at the non striker's end. Yigesh fired the throw- he could have just lobbed it.- The throw bounces on the pitch and moves towards Irfan who fails to collect it! Paul decided late to sacrifice his wicket and starts to run across but by then the ball had passed Irfan

The ball is swinging and I am surprised Gilchrist is trying to drive it to  straight rather than repeat what he did the last ball of the previous Irfan over when he drove with the swing. This one flies off the outside edge to third man.
Huge slog and a miss. This wasn't a swing; this was a slog. He leaned forward and tried to heave it from well outside off to the leg side. No luck. The ball tails away from him.
hurls this fuller and Paul is tentative. He is late in getting forward and when he does, he gets the edge on the iffy drive. The ball falls short of the slips
This one is a bouncer and Paul ducks
this one tails in towards off and Paul ends up jabbing it to the off side
Whoa! Three times in a row. Too good for Paul. This is a peachy delivery; straightening outside off and extra bounce as well.
And again. Lovely delivery in the zone outside off and Paul pokes at it and the ball rushes past the outside edge
kicks up from a good length and also, straightens. The combination was too much for Paul, who was beaten, pushing inside the line
wide delivery outside off and the keeper collects that
Good news. Gilchrist has connected with a shot. Bad news. Irfan didn't get it to swing much. Gilchrist leaned forward and across and creamed this full delivery through wide mid-off region
Good news. Irfan is swinging the white ball. Bad news. Gilchrist is not connecting with his shots. This was an outswinger and Gilchrist ended up driving too far inside the line
around the off stump area, Gilchrist covers the away movement and steers to backward point
Swing and a miss. It's a wide outswinger outside off and Gilly went after it but the ball curved past the edge
lands around the middle and moves towards off and middle, Gilchrist gets behind the line to push it back down the track
kicks up from short of length and Paul is surprised. He hops, gets the bottom-hand working overtime and ends up stabbing the ball aerially through backward square-leg reigon
Punjab have won their third game in a row. This was a slower one and the batsman couldn't get bat on ball. Punjab remain in the hunt for the spot in final four.
shortish delivery outside off, he tries to drag it to the on side but fails to connect
low full toss, Morkel mistimes his drive out to long-off
Drilled! He backed away outside leg and thumped this full-length delivery over mid-off
moves outside leg and slashes the bouncer up and over third man. It flea off the top edge

run out missed by Gilly. It was pulled weakly towards long-on.. David Hussey throws it on the bounce at the striker's ends and it skids rapidly to Gilly who couldn't collect it cleanly. The batsman was well short of the crease
And again. The slogs aren't working. Gilly keeps taking them.
in the corridor outside off and it goes past the attempted heave
Run out missed fullish delivery around off, squeezed out to point. The throw comes but misses the stumps.
walks right across the stumps and tries to swing to the on side. He misses and the ball nails  him on the off stump line. Trapped!
pushes it away for a single
drilled to right of long-on where David Hussey makes a nice diving save
dropped by Dinesh Karthik Another bouncer, another pull shot and Dk waits at the midwicket boundary. He couldn't repeat Ryan's efforts though. He pouched the ball but it slipped out of his hands
bangs in a bouncer and it climbs over the attempted pull. It's been given as a wide and PK isn't impressed
back of length outside off and he has flat-batted it high over mid-off.

Wow! What an effort from Ryan Harris. Travis pulled the short ball and I was sure it had sailed over deep midwicket boundary. Ryan leaps near the ropes, arches back while in the air, plucks the ball with one hand and manages to land back inside the playing arena. Phew. Gem.
bowls a shortish ball from a very short run up and Travis flat-bats it high over long-off. Crunchy
Another swing and a miss. Gilly throws the ball back to Praveen
moves outside leg and has a go at this length delivery which ends up bouncing over the stumps
high bouncer and the batsman sways away from the line
short in length outside off, pushed out to point
on the pads again, rolls away behind square-leg
on the leg stump line, jabbed to square-leg. The bowler and two other fielders from the deep converge but the batsmen had enough time to turn back for the second
shortish, just outside off stump, Birt upper cuts it over short third man fielder.
Ah the idea shot. He was withdrawing his bat away from the line of the delivery but the ball runs off the face of the bat to third man
Loud appeal for a catch by Gilly. It was a full delivery outside off and Birt went for a big off drive; the bat hit the ground and GIlly pouched the ball
skips down the track and chips it up and over midwicket in some style.
googly on the middle, turned to midwicket
jumps from a length, edged to the leg side
Delhi are now hope less. James goes for a sweep but top-edges the leg break and Gilly settles under it
fullish delivery outside off, pushed down to long-on
waits for the slower ball to arrive and the short length helps him to pull it hard to the midwicket boundary
he keeps bowling those slower ones, this one has been steered to point
full in length and slower of course, pushed back to the bowler
More joy for the Punjab camp. Irfan drags this short ball towards deep square-leg where Mandeep sinks on his knees and lunges forward to take it.
slower one outside off, Hopes forces it to long-off
tries to paddle sweep, misses and the leg break hits him on the pad outside off
Delhi are going down. Punjab stay alive in the competition. It was a tossed-up delivery outside off and Venu lofted it to long-off
Chawla shortens the length again as he sees Venu trying to get down the track; venu jabs it to the off
goes down the track but the leg break dips on him and he lunges forward to defend
full delivery, almost a yorker, dragged off the inside edge to square-leg

Six or catch? DK, who takes it, says it's a six. Let me explain: Venu swung the full delivery to deep midwicket where DK caught it, standing at the edge of the boundary line. He stumbled back, popped the ball back into play and went over the line but I guess he knew that he had touched the ropes when he stepped back and was still holding the ball.
fullish around leg stump line, rolls off the pad for a leg bye
dabs this past square-leg
full and well outside off, Venu reaches out to slash it off the edge to third man boundary
slower one on the off and middle line, turned to vacant spaces in midwicket for couple of runs.
moves down the track and drags this to long-on
sweeps this leg break aerially but short of deep backward square-leg fielder
turns in from outside off, Irfan leans forward to defend
gets this away for a single to the leg side
goes for a sweep but fails to connect

done in by the googly. Delhi are wobbling  away like drunk men. Sriram top-edged the sweep and DK moved  from first slip towards leg gully,and avoided a collision with the square-leg fielder,  to take the catch.
around the off stump, pushed out to covers
plays another cut shot to pick up a single
a slower one outside off stump and Sriram lunges across and ends up dragging it high towards long-on but it falls short of the fielder
on the middle and off line, Sriram goes for the cut but is cramped for room and edges it to cover point
slower one angling across Sriram who mistimes the cut shot to covers
leans forward to defend the full-length delivery to the leg side
on the pads, rolls out to square-leg region
full and in the zone outside off, Venu is beaten, driving inside the line

Shalabh Srivastava hugs Adam. Priety Zinta does her hop-skip-and-jump routine. Warner walked down the track and went for a big swing to the on side. The ball just about straightened on that leg and middle line and that meant Warner got a leading edge. The ball swirled really high in the air and Gilly called for the catch and ran past Warner to take it.
on the middle stump line, back of length and Warner plays a nice swat-pull and drags it to deep square-leg boundary
lands short of length and kicks up, Warner has a poke at it but its Gilly who gets it
around the off stump line, steered to left of backward point
stays back to run this down to third man for a single
the slower one outside off and it goes past the defensive push and rolls through to the keeper
mistimes a cut shot and gets a single
edged over short third man. Warner went for the good-old leg side slog - the bottom-hand slipped off the bat- and the ball flew over to third man boundadry
slower one from wide of the crease, pushed out to the off side
full pitched around off and Warner crashes it between the bowler and the umpire.
full delivery around off, tapped back to the bowler

Shalabh has his revenge and doesn't realise he has got it!  He gets this length delivery to slant across Naman who tries to run it down to third man and gets the outside edge. Srivastava didn't see the edge and turned back when he saw the umpire's verdict. He swung back in great delight.
around the off stump line, defended to the off side
slightly slower, outside off, Warner drags it to deep square-leg
punches this length delivery on the up but straight to extra cover
full in length, from over the wicket, angling across Naman who gets an inside edge to fine-leg
gets forward to chip the full delivery up and over midwicket but the fielder at the deep mops up
gets back to dab this to midwicket for a single
slides away from the off stump line, short in length, Warner goes for the cut and gets a thick edge and it runs past the slip fielder
slower, fuller around off, eased through cover point
on the middle and leg line, turned through midwicket for a single
beaten by the googly. It landed around off  and spun away from Warner who went for the big off drive and missed
slider around off stump line, going away from Warner who nudges it to backward point
short in length, lands outside off, cuts in towards middle, jabbed away to covers
backs away and tries to cut the shortish delivery outside off but misses. The third man was up in the circle and had Naman connected, he would have collected another boundary
Wallop. It's a length delivery coming in from round the stumps and Naman blasts it up and over long-on.
Naman goes for a big slog across the line, misses, and the ball tails past the off stump
Six over deep point! Whoa! It was a full delivery angling away from Naman, who leaned across to slice it high over backward point!
short and wide and Naman spanks it high over point. Easy as easy gets.
slants this across and outside off stump. Wide.
lands full in length around middle and off and Warner crouches forward to defend but the ball cuts away past the edge
Warner walks down the pitch, PK hurled across a bouncer and Warner went for the pull. The ball flew off the top edge over fine-leg boundary
The ball cuts in and Naman, who likes width, can't do much with it; he just pushes it towards mid-on
gets back and across to jab a delivery coming in to the middle and off line back to the bowler
moves in towards leg and middle, nudged to the on side

Screamer! It curved in the air from outside off, landed back of length outside off and seamed in sharply. Naman had decided to shoulder arms and to his surprise the ball kept coming back in but it hit this thigh pad and bobbed away to Gilly
leans forward to defend the full-length delivery to mid-off
on the middle and leg line, clipped through backward square-leg
Ryan too pings Warner on the leg stump line. Warner is cramped for room and it rolls off the thigh pad
cuts in from the middle stump line, moves to the leg stump line and rolls off the thigh pad
in the channel outside off and Naman has a lazy waft at it and the ball flies through to Gilly
crouches to jab this one out to covers
moves across Warner who defends to the off side. Mike Haysman says that's PK's fourth maiden over in this season.
And again on that leg stump line and Warner nudges it to midwicket
lands on a length outside leg and moves towards leg stump. Warner is not fluent off his pads and just pushes this ball to midwicket
stays back to work it to midwicket
screamer! It landed back of length around leg stump and cut away sharply. A surprised Warner lets it go through to the keeper
on the pads, turned straight to midwicket
straightens outside off and Naman reaches out to push it to point
on the middle stump line, turned to midwicket
drifts down the leg side for a wide
leans forward to club this length delivery up and over mid-on and punches Warner's gloves
Ouch. It kicks up sharply from a length and that takes the batsman by surprise. He tries to stab it down and the ball rears up to hit his body.
in the zone outside off, left alone
fullish, on the pads, rolls away to midwicket region
around the off stump line, dabbed to backward point
the inswinger that lands around around off and middle and then seams away sharply past the pads.
on the middle stump line and Naman pushes it back to PK
short in length and outside off, steered past backward point for couple of runs. Two slips in place.
on the pads again this time to the left-handed Warner who works it past square-leg for another single
on the pads, flicked past square-leg for a single
